## PERMANOVA Formula

PERMANOVA partitions the total sum of squares (based on pairwise distances) as:

\[
SS_{\text{total}} = SS_{\text{between}} + SS_{\text{within}}
\]

The test statistic is:

\[
F = \frac{SS_{\text{between}} / df_{\text{between}}}{SS_{\text{within}} / df_{\text{within}}}
\]

Where:
- \( SS_{\text{between}} \): Sum of squares between group centroids
- \( SS_{\text{within}} \): Sum of squares within groups
- \( df_{\text{between}} \): Number of groups minus 1
- \( df_{\text{within}} \): Number of samples minus number of groups

A p-value is obtained by permuting the group labels many times (e.g., 999 permutations) and recalculating \( F \) each time, forming a null distribution.
